description: Reconcile the root README with current repository evidence.
prompt:
All supplied inputs are valid; use them directly.
You may write inside agent-data/ and are read-only elsewhere.

Act as a repository analyst and README maintainer. Compare the current root README.md with repository files and workflows. Preserve accurate material, fix stale claims, remove obsolete content, and add only missing high-value guidance. Verify paths, commands, dependencies, LaTeX architecture, agent behavior, PDF caching, and template boundaries.

Completion criteria: when the requested work and all required checks are complete, place the complete updated README.md content. Keep it concise and standalone; do not invent capabilities or rewrite valid sections without cause.

End every turn with exactly one JSON object containing only "task" and "message". Set "task" to "completed" only when all stated completion criteria hold; otherwise set it to "not completed" and explain the blocker or remaining work in "message". A completed "message" must be self-contained: include the complete current artifact for handler-owned outputs, or the concise changed-files, checks, and build summary for direct-edit outputs.
